name: tpl-precedence-2-goal
task: Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. Reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Precedence(door_open, key_lost) hard captures the ban on dropping the key before the door has been opened once (the task's 'until the door has been opened once' wording keeps the condition as Precedence, and after the door opens dropping is allowed, which the machine permits from u2). Existence(at_goal) hard is the required goal and is not redundant, since Precedence alone forces nothing; FINAL_STATES u3 is correctly present.
